tabs.html:
DeepCool PN750D 750W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

Power up your next-gen system with confidence using the DeepCool PN750D 750W Power Supply, designed for efficiency, performance, and future compatibility. With 80 PLUS Gold certification, it delivers up to 90% energy efficiency, ensuring reduced heat output and lower power consumption.

Compliant with the latest ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.0 standards, this power supply includes a 12VHPWR cable for full support of NVIDIA RTX 40 series GPUs. The non-modular design is ideal for straightforward, budget-conscious builds, while the 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan ensures quiet and durable cooling performance.

The DeepCool PN750D 750W 80 Plus Gold Non-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is designed to power modern gaming rigs and workstation systems with superior stability and efficiency. Built with the newest ATX 3.1 standard, this PSU ensures full compatibility with next-generation graphics cards through its native 12V-2×6 (16-pin) PCIe power connector, delivering clean and reliable power to even the most demanding GPUs.


With 80 Plus Gold certification, the PN750D offers excellent power efficiency, reducing energy loss and heat output. Its advanced Full Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC topology ensures stable voltage regulation and consistent performance, especially under heavy load conditions.


A durable 120mm Hydro Bearing fan provides optimized airflow and quiet operation, making it ideal for gaming, rendering, streaming, and heavy multitasking. The PSU includes essential built-in protections such as OCP, OVP, OPP, UVP, SCP, and OTP, keeping your components safe from electrical hazards.


Backed by a reliable 10-year manufacturer warranty, the DeepCool PN750D is a powerful, long-lasting, and future-ready choice for PC builders in Bangladesh who need premium performance without the premium
